title: Look up the IP address of a domain
summary: Use the `dig` command to find the IP addresses associated with a website or domain name. This is useful for checking where a domain points or troubleshooting connection issues.

steps.explain: Query the DNS for the A records (IPv4 addresses) of the specified domain. The `+short` flag makes the output concise, showing only the IP addresses.

placeholders.name: DOMAIN
placeholders.description: The domain name to look up, e.g. example.com

steps.expect: A list of IP addresses associated with the domain.
